findings.current: “Keep your eyes straight ahead before I gouge them out.”
findings.defect: “눈 똑바로 떠라” tells him to open his eyes properly; it does not tell him to look straight ahead. The translation changes the physical instruction.
findings.rationale: The source pairs an instruction to open his eyes with the threat to gouge them out. It says nothing about directing his gaze forward.
findings.replacement: “Keep your eyes open before I gouge them out.”

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one small change to the physical meaning of a threat.
